vb_textbox.text: My advice is to choose the brighter colors in each round, after some certain period of time and you have noticed you are not able to pick any more mushrooms, go on to pick the colors like grey, brown and any other dull colors in each round. Make sure to keep alternating picking of colors so as to get enough mushrooms for each round. You just have to be sure that you are very aware and alert to monitor the number of mushrooms you collect into the basket.
